In RuleSpeak®

The individual's nephritis progression state key is determined by the following priority:

  1. “BiopsyIndicated” if the max progression state order is at least 5
  2. “RenalFlareRisk” if the max progression state order is at least 4
  3. “EarlyNephritis” if the max progression state order is at least 3
  4. “SerologicActive” if the max progression state order is at least 2
  5. “PresymptomaticAutoimmunity” in all other cases
In plain words

If max progression state order is at least 5 then "BiopsyIndicated", otherwise if max progression state order is at least 4 then "RenalFlareRisk", otherwise if max progression state order is at least 3 then "EarlyNephritis", otherwise if max progression state order is at least 2 then "SerologicActive", otherwise "PresymptomaticAutoimmunity".

As a formula
= IF(Max Progression State Order>=5,"BiopsyIndicated",IF(Max Progression State Order>=4,"RenalFlareRisk",IF(Max Progression State Order>=3,"EarlyNephritis",IF(Max Progression State Order>=2,"SerologicActive","PresymptomaticAutoimmunity"))))

ƒ Treatment Response Deciding Factor Calculated 10 hops from ground truth string DR-100
In RuleSpeak®

The treatment's treatment response deciding factor is determined by the following priority:

  1. “EffectiveOnConfirmedMechanism” if the treatment response predicted flag is set
  2. “NoConfirmedMechanism” if the mechanism matched flag is not set
  3. “AdverseEffect” if the adverse effect flag is set
  4. “NoResponse” if any of these hold:
    • the treatment response is “None”
    • the treatment response is “Adverse”
  5. “Undetermined” in all other cases
In plain words

If is treatment response predicted then "EffectiveOnConfirmedMechanism", otherwise if not is mechanism matched then "NoConfirmedMechanism", otherwise if has adverse effect then "AdverseEffect", otherwise if treatment response is "None" or treatment response is "Adverse" then "NoResponse", otherwise "Undetermined".

As a formula
= IF(Is Treatment Response Predicted, "EffectiveOnConfirmedMechanism", IF(NOT(Is Mechanism Matched), "NoConfirmedMechanism", IF(Has Adverse Effect, "AdverseEffect", IF(OR(Treatment Response = "None", Treatment Response = "Adverse"), "NoResponse", "Undetermined"))))
Inputs 4 fields this rule reads

The individual prediction's lifecycle state key is determined by the following priority:

If is high confidence prediction, is falsifiability backed, is ancestry transport safe, and predicted value is greater than 0 then "Actionable", otherwise if not rests on confirmed mechanism or not is falsifiability backed then "NotActionable", otherwise if individual has cryptic relatedness then "NotActionable", otherwise if calibrated uncertainty is less than 0.7 then "NotActionable", otherwise if not is ancestry transport safe then "NotActionable", otherwise "Actionable".

If predicted probability band is at least observed event rate then (predicted probability band minus observed event rate), otherwise (observed event rate minus predicted probability band).

As a formula

In RuleSpeak®

A machine state's reachable state count is the number of vw state transition rules closure related to the machine state.

In plain words

Count of vw state transition rules closure whose from ID is machine state ID.

As a formula
= COUNTIFS(From ID, Machine State ID)
Inputs 1 fields this rule reads
●Machine State IDMachine State Slug PK, e.g. diagnosis-lifecycle--intake.
Consumers 1 direct rules that read this one
↗ Reachable States Ahead Individual
Ground truth at the leaves 1 the raw values this ultimately depends on
● Machine State ID Machine State

Number of states reachable FROM this state via the transitive closure of the transition edges (rollup over vw_state_transition_rules_closure where from_id = this state). This is a graph-reachability fact the linear severity rank CANNOT reproduce: both Quiescent (the remission sink) and BiopsyIndicated (the terminal progression state) have 0 reachable-ahead, though they sit at opposite ends of the order — the count is non-monotonic in OrderIndex because the machine BRANCHES (remission). The closure is load-bearing here: delete it and this field is uncomputable.

In RuleSpeak®

In plain words

This roll-up is defined structurally over a relationship — no spreadsheet formula to read aloud. See RuleSpeak®.

As a formula

No spreadsheet formula — a structural roll-up. See RuleSpeak®.

Transitive closure of state-machine transitions (an owl:TransitiveProperty). The asserted FromState->ToState edges imply the full reachability ordering of each machine - including never-asserted long-range pairs such as PresymptomaticAutoimmunity -> BiopsyIndicated. Materialized by the transpiler as the cycle-safe recursive view vw_state_transition_rules_closure(from_id, to_id, hop_distance, is_inferred): asserted edges (hop 1) plus inferred reachability rows. The disease trajectory is derived from the transition topology, not hand-asserted.

ƒ Anti Ds Dna Trend Calculated 2 hops from ground truth string DR-258
In RuleSpeak®

The serology observation's anti ds dna trend is determined by the following priority:

  1. “Stable” if the prior anti ds dna IU is blank
  2. “Rising” if the anti ds dna IU is greater than the prior anti ds dna IU times 1.25
  3. “Falling” if the anti ds dna IU is less than the prior anti ds dna IU times 0.8
  4. “Stable” in all other cases
In plain words

If prior anti ds dna IU is blank then "Stable", otherwise if anti ds dna IU is greater than (prior anti ds dna IU times 1.25) then "Rising", otherwise if anti ds dna IU is less than (prior anti ds dna IU times 0.8) then "Falling", otherwise "Stable".

As a formula
= IF(ISBLANK(Prior Anti Ds Dna IU),"Stable",IF(Anti Ds Dna IU>Prior Anti Ds Dna IU*1.25,"Rising",IF(Anti Ds Dna IU<Prior Anti Ds Dna IU*0.8,"Falling","Stable")))
Inputs 2 fields this rule reads
↗Prior Anti Ds Dna IUSerology Observation The anti ds dna IU of the linked prior observation. ●Anti Ds Dna IUSerology Observation anti-dsDNA titre IU/mL (RAW lab).

ƒ Complement Trend Calculated 2 hops from ground truth string DR-259
In RuleSpeak®

The serology observation's complement trend is determined by the following priority:

  1. “Stable” if the prior c3 is blank
  2. “Falling” if the complement c3 plus the complement c4 is less than the prior c3 plus the prior c4 times 0.85
  3. “Rising” if the complement c3 plus the complement c4 is greater than the prior c3 plus the prior c4 times 1.15
  4. “Stable” in all other cases
In plain words

If prior c3 is blank then "Stable", otherwise if (complement c3 plus complement c4) is less than ((prior c3 plus prior c4) times 0.85) then "Falling", otherwise if (complement c3 plus complement c4) is greater than ((prior c3 plus prior c4) times 1.15) then "Rising", otherwise "Stable".

As a formula
= IF(ISBLANK(Prior C3),"Stable",IF((Complement C3+Complement C4)<(Prior C3+Prior C4)*0.85,"Falling",IF((Complement C3+Complement C4)>(Prior C3+Prior C4)*1.15,"Rising","Stable")))
Inputs 4 fields this rule reads

ƒ Progression State Key Calculated 3 hops from ground truth string DR-266
In RuleSpeak®

The serology observation's progression state key is determined by the following priority:

  1. “BiopsyIndicated” if any of these hold:
    • the nephrotic range proteinuria flag is set
    • the active urinary sediment flag is set
  2. “RenalFlareRisk” if the proteinuria g per day is at least 1.0
  3. “EarlyNephritis” if the significant proteinuria flag is set
  4. “SerologicActive” if all of these hold:
    • the anti ds dna trend is “Rising”
    • the complement trend is “Falling”
  5. “PresymptomaticAutoimmunity” in all other cases
In plain words

If is nephrotic range proteinuria or has active urinary sediment then "BiopsyIndicated", otherwise if proteinuria g per day is at least 1.0 then "RenalFlareRisk", otherwise if is significant proteinuria then "EarlyNephritis", otherwise if anti ds dna trend is "Rising" and complement trend is "Falling" then "SerologicActive", otherwise "PresymptomaticAutoimmunity".

As a formula
= IF(OR(Is Nephrotic Range Proteinuria,Has Active Urinary Sediment),"BiopsyIndicated",IF(Proteinuria G Per Day>=1.0,"RenalFlareRisk",IF(Is Significant Proteinuria,"EarlyNephritis",IF(AND(Anti Ds Dna Trend="Rising",Complement Trend="Falling"),"SerologicActive","PresymptomaticAutoimmunity"))))
